chunks: On that day no intercession will be of use except for one to whom the Most Merciful grants permission and accepts his speech.
ai.seo_question: Who can intercede on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores that intercession (shafa'ah) is not an independent right but a privilege granted exclusively by Allah, contingent upon His pleasure and the intercessor's alignment with divine will. It highlights the conditional nature of the Prophet's and Imams' intercession, which serves to guide believers toward righteous conduct rather than absolving them of accountability. This reinforces the Shia doctrine that intercession is a mercy for those who have earned it through faith and good deeds, as approved by the Divine.
